residual_risks: Ordinary pane drag selection remains failed in native Windows + WezTerm + rmux foreground retest.
Current mouse on policy routes pane mouse events through application mouse reporting, so WezTerm GUI-native selection is not proven by rmux binding snapshots.
Changing the result from blocked to pass requires an approved strategy and fresh foreground validation: mouse reporting off, explicit modifier bypass, or a non-native copy-mode alternative.
